notes.title: Minor Patch - 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello, players!

This is just a minor maintenance patch to fix some found typos. It should not affect any save files, but let me know if you have issues. Thanks for playing!

~ Corvaena

notes.title: The Dust of the Violet Crystals - Apocalyptic Visual Novel - Now free to play!
notes.notes:
Hello potential readers!

Very excited to release The Dust of the Violet Crystals on Steam for free!

DotVC was my first attempt at a full game as a solo/indie developer, and the game has been polished up and had Steam achievements added for a free release on the platform.

This is a short story with multiple endings. Which will you achieve?

Thank you for your time, and I hope you enjoy!


~ Corvaena
